## Highlights
### New
- Crest blocks ads and trackers on every page, on Mac, iPhone and iPad, with EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock Origin’s lists and a list for your language, which stay up to date on their own. Blocked ads leave no empty boxes, floating video players are hidden, and the lists’ fixes for sites that fight ad blockers run too. Add your own lists or filters in a Space’s privacy settings, choose Block Element to hide anything the lists miss, and turn blocking off for a site from the page’s actions.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
